description: Le potentiel éolien à Roubaix is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Métropole Européenne de Lille . The city of Roubaix commissioned Unéole to carry out a study to categorise the areas of the municipality according to the distribution of wind speeds. We present here the area where the wind deposit is excellent, i.e. the well-exposed area whatever the direction of the wind and where the wind potential is the most important. Coverage: Métropole Européenne de Lille . The portal shows the English title as "Wind potential in Roubaix" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Métropole Européenne de Lille . Its keywords include environnement-energie, vent, amenagement-urbanisme-foncier, eolienne, amenage. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
